title: SQL Injection (CWE-89) in Tenant User Search Query
pr_title: feat(search): dynamic user lookup for workspace directory
summary: AI generated database query uses direct python f-string interpolation into a raw SQL query string without escaping or binding parameters.
impact: Data Exfiltration & Compliance Breach (CWE-89): Attackers can supply SQL injection escape sequences to bypass tenant isolation and dump passwords, API keys, and sensitive enterprise credentials.
root_cause: String interpolation `raw_sql = f"... '{search_query}'"` executes unchecked user input inside the SQL parser.
proposed_fix_summary: Replace raw SQL string formatting with parameterized query bindings (`?` or named parameters).
